name: Kanga cloth
about: A printed cotton cloth worn by women across East Africa. Many kangas carry Swahili proverbs, which is why they are a favorite souvenir of Dar es Salaam.
tip: Check that the cloth was made in East Africa before you buy.

name: Tinga Tinga painting
about: A Tanzanian painting style with bold colors and animal scenes. It was made famous by artists in Dar es Salaam.
tip: Ask if the canvas can be rolled for transport.

name: Tanzanite
about: A blue-violet gemstone found only in Tanzania. It is a local treasure, and Dar es Salaam is a main place to buy it.
tip: Insist on a certificate, because fake stones are common on the street.
